summary: 49 publish, 24 publish_flagged, 0 reject. All 56 sources and all 185 evidence items, including nested figures and metrics, were re-fetched and checked. Systemic caveats: publisher full text for APS/Elsevier/Wiley articles was often unavailable, so Crossref establishes peer review while result numbers remain tied to fetched arXiv versions; undated roadmap/product pages use the 2026-10-01 access date; Wukong-72's material specifications remain Tier 3; several installed systems use the documented host as operator; and no named facility supports Garnet/Emerald, Toshiko, Zuchongzhi, Wukong or Tianyan. Rejected ids: none. LRZ coordinates agree exactly with trapped_ion.json.
